inputs.prompt:
Use `<image1>` as the only outfit reference.

Create a photorealistic wardrobe reference sheet that breaks down the outfit in `<image1>`. Show attire only, not the person. No face, no skin, no visible body, no mannequin and no dress form of any kind — the garments hold their shape as ghost-mannequin volumes, hollow and empty, with an open empty neckline, empty sleeve openings and nothing inside them.

Extract and preserve from `<image1>`: every garment present, its silhouette and layering, its cut, its true colours, its fabric, weave and sheen, its print or pattern, its seams, stitching, buttons, zips, fastenings, belts, straps, pockets and hems, and its proportions — with the garment count exactly as `<image1>` shows it. The outfit is a single one-piece dress and it stays exactly one piece: a fitted two-tone dress whose close-fitting bodice is solid black from a clean V neckline down to the waist and whose skirt is one solid mid-red from the waist to just above the knee, cut as a narrow pencil skirt, with short set-in sleeves ending at mid-upper-arm, no collar, no lapel and no visible button, zip or fastening on the front, a shallow horizontal seam joining the black bodice to the red skirt at the natural waist, and a plain straight hem just above the knee. The set is completed by the pair of black pointed-toe high-heeled pumps shown in `<image1>`, each with a closed pointed toe, a low-cut vamp and a slim heel.

If some parts are hidden, reconstruct them logically and consistently from the visible design: show the back of the dress with the rear neckline cut to the same depth as the front V, the centre-back seam of the bodice, the back waist seam continuing level with the front, the rear skirt line with its plain hem and its short back vent, the inside of the sleeve openings and the hem, and both pumps of the pair as a complete matched set.

Use a multi-panel layout: one full-outfit front view, one full-outfit back view and one full-outfit side view — each with the pair of black pumps standing side by side at the bottom of the frame in the position feet would occupy, angled slightly outward — plus a column of zoomed detail tiles for the V neckline and its edge finish, the black-to-red waist seam, the short sleeve and its opening, the surface of the black bodice fabric, the surface of the red skirt fabric, the hem, and the pumps' pointed toes and slim heels.

Set the whole sheet on one single plain seamless light-grey studio backdrop held at one even value: the same backdrop behind the full-outfit views and behind every detail tile, with no darker, black, charcoal or gradient background anywhere in the frame.

Light every tile with the same neutral, bright studio light, evenly exposed, with soft shadows and accurate colour reproduction, so the black bodice stays a deep solid black with its own soft surface sheen and never turns charcoal, grey or blue, the red skirt stays one clean true red and never turns orange, maroon, pink or dusty, and the black pumps match the bodice exactly, in every view and every tile.

Style: professional costume department wardrobe board, clean layout, neutral studio background, realistic fabric, seams and footwear, sharp detail, production-ready presentation.

Important: preserve the outfit faithfully, do not redesign it, do not turn it into a character sheet, do not show a human model or any mannequin, do not add a bag, jewellery, a belt or any accessory `<image1>` does not show, keep the result photorealistic and detailed, and carry no embroidery or lettering anywhere.

inputs.prompt:
Edit <image1> into a finished studio photograph. Keep <image1> as the canvas: the single standing figure at the same height, position and scale, the same camera height, the same pale grey seamless backdrop with its continuous sweep into the floor, the same soft even light from the front left, and the same faint contact shadows under the feet — all exactly as they are.

Change the figure from a white mannequin into a real woman, and change her clothes. Her body is entirely human: real skin on her neck, both shoulders, both arms, both wrists, both hands with five separated fingers and visible knuckles, both thighs, both knees, both calves, both ankles and both feet with five toes each, all in one even natural skin tone. No white resin, no ball-and-socket joint, no dark joint seam and no doll-like articulation remains anywhere on her body.

Her face is a plain, ordinary young East Asian face with no strong features: her head is level and square to the lens, her eyes open and looking into the camera, her forehead fully visible with her hair swept back off it, her eyebrows light, her lips closed and her expression neutral and calm. Her face fills about one tenth of the picture height, nothing covers it, and she wears almost no makeup.

She is dressed in the outfit from <image2>, one piece in total: a fitted two-tone dress whose bodice is solid black from a clean V neckline down to the natural waist and whose skirt is one solid mid-red from the waist to just above the knee, cut as a narrow pencil skirt, with short set-in sleeves ending at mid-upper-arm, no collar and no visible fastening on the front. The black stays a deep solid black with a soft sheen, the red stays one clean true red and never turns orange, maroon or pink, the horizontal seam at the waist stays level and continuous, and nothing in the outfit turns charcoal or grey.

The garment sits on her the way real clothes sit on a body: the V neckline lies flat across her collarbones with no gap and no gaping, the short sleeves end at mid-upper-arm and sit on her shoulder points, the bodice follows her waist without pulling or wrinkling across the chest, the black-to-red seam crosses her natural waist in one level line, and the pencil skirt falls straight from the waist to just above her knees, clearing them without riding up. The fabric breaks in a soft fold at the inside of each elbow as her arms hang free at her sides.

She wears the black pointed-toe high-heeled pumps from <image2> on both feet, with the pointed toe closed, the vamp cut low across the top of the foot and the heel raised, and her feet are fully enclosed in them.
